# Asset Prompter

> Asset Prompter is a free, small local app for Windows and Linux that carries prompts and results between your coding agent and the image or video generator you use by hand. Your agent writes the prompt. You make the picture.

Asset Prompter is for people who build a website, an app or a project with a coding agent and make its images and video by hand in a generator they already use, often one without a public API. It answers questions such as "how do I get Claude Code, Codex or Cursor to ask for images from Midjourney, Google Flow or ChatGPT Images?" and "how do I hand prompts from my agent to an image generator without API keys?"

- How it works: the agent writes each prompt and its settings into a slot folder. You copy the prompt into your generator, press Generate there, and drop the result on the slot's card. The agent can open the result and ask for changes; you approve the one you want, and it becomes the final file the agent uses. Every version, result, change request and review stays in the folder as plain files.
- For the agent: it sees every version, makes crops, sizes and formats from the approved file without a new generation, and checks video clips it can't play through frame sheets (one per second, four frames each) and a motion map.
- Agents: any agent that can read and write files in the project folder, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode and Antigravity.
- Generators: any tool you can paste a prompt into. Presets ship for ChatGPT Images, Dreamina, Google Flow, Grok Imagine, Leonardo.Ai, Luma AI and Midjourney.
- Compared with an MCP server: to the agent the steps are the same (ask, wait, get the file, try again); only the far end changes, because you generate instead of a provider's servers. If a generator has an official MCP server, you may not need this.
- Trade-off: it doesn't generate anything itself. You press Generate in your own tool, every time. For batches that run while you are away, pick a generator with an API or an MCP server.
- It listens on 127.0.0.1 only, has no account and needs no API key. It costs nothing; you pay for your generator and your agent. Source code under the MIT licence. Setup covers Windows and Linux; on macOS you install Bun yourself.
- To install it with an agent, give the agent this message: "Install Asset Prompter for me: follow https://github.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter/blob/master/AGENT-INSTALL.md"
- Made by Đorđe Novaković (Djordje Novaković; GitHub: Djordje1998, LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/dj-nov). Not affiliated with or endorsed by any of the named agents or generators.

## Pages

- [Asset Prompter](https://assetprompter.com/): the website in English, with the six steps of one picture, the comparison with MCP servers, what the folder gives the agent, the uses, the trade-offs, installing and the questions
- [Full text for AI assistants](https://assetprompter.com/llms-full.txt): the whole website as one Markdown file, with the use cases, the six steps, the comparison, the trade-offs, the install steps and every question and answer
- [Asset Prompter na srpskom](https://assetprompter.com/sr/): the same website in Serbian

## Guides

Written by the maker of Asset Prompter, each dated (8 October 2026) and linked to its sources.

- [Guides](https://assetprompter.com/guides/): the list of guides
- [How the pictures on this site were made](https://assetprompter.com/guides/how-this-site-was-made/): the Asset Prompter slots behind the site's illustrations and clips, the slot folder, what the Google Flow preset tells the agent, how the app turns a clip into frame sheets and a motion map, and how the approved files were exported (WebP, H.264 and AV1)
- [Which image and video generators have an API or an MCP server](https://assetprompter.com/guides/image-generators-api-mcp/): a dated, sourced table of ChatGPT Images, Midjourney, Google Flow, Dreamina, Grok Imagine, Leonardo.Ai, Luma, Higgsfield, Ideogram, Krea, Kling and Runway, and of the image generation built into Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, Gemini CLI and Claude Code
- [Five ways to get generated images and video into your coding agent's project](https://assetprompter.com/guides/get-images-into-coding-agent-project/): the agent's own image tool, an official MCP server, a paid API, copy and paste, or a shared folder; who presses Generate in each, what it costs, and when you don't need Asset Prompter
- [Vodiči na srpskom](https://assetprompter.com/sr/guides/): the same guides in Serbian, each at the same path under /sr/ (for example https://assetprompter.com/sr/guides/image-generators-api-mcp/)

## Docs

- [Agent install guide](https://github.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter/blob/master/AGENT-INSTALL.md): the steps an agent follows to download, set up, check and start the app
- [Agent install guide, raw Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter/master/AGENT-INSTALL.md): the same guide as a plain text file, for tools that fetch a file
- [README](https://github.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter/blob/master/README.md): what the app does, how it works, which agents and generators it works with, what the agent gets, the folder layout and the presets
- [Repository](https://github.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter): the source code, under the MIT licence

## Optional

- [Download ZIP](https://github.com/Djordje1998/asset-prompter/archive/refs/heads/master.zip): the app's folder; run setup.bat on Windows or sh setup.sh on Linux
